content.value_statement: Teams sometimes need Lark or Feishu APIs that are not wrapped by existing skills or CLI commands. This skill finds official OpenAPI documentation and prepares safe lark-cli api calls.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether existing Lark skills or lark-cli commands already cover the request.
Locates relevant modules in official Feishu or Lark OpenAPI documentation.
Extracts API methods, paths, parameters, permissions, responses, and error details from docs.
Prepares lark-cli api request examples for common OpenAPI methods.
Translates Chinese documentation details into English when the user works in English.
Requires confirmation before write, update, or delete API calls.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and valid Feishu or Lark authentication.
Depends on official documentation being reachable through WebFetch.
Does not grant API scopes or tenant permissions by itself.
Sensitive write or delete operations still need human review.

use_cases.title: Find an Unwrapped API
use_cases.description: Locate an official endpoint for a workflow that existing Lark skills and CLI commands do not cover.

use_cases.title: Prepare Admin Changes
use_cases.description: Review membership or announcement APIs before making one-time workspace changes with explicit approval.

use_cases.title: Plan Automation Coverage
use_cases.description: Compare current CLI coverage with raw OpenAPI options before building a repeatable integration.

prompt_templates.title: Find an API
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official Feishu OpenAPI endpoint for [task]. Check existing lark-cli commands first, then summarize the method, path, required parameters, and permissions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Read Call
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Lark documentation to prepare a read-only lark-cli api request for [resource]. Include required query parameters, response fields, and possible errors.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Write Call
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to update [resource] in Feishu. Find the official API, explain required scopes, describe the request fields, and ask for confirmation before any write action.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Determine whether [workflow] is covered by existing Lark skills or requires raw OpenAPI. If raw OpenAPI is needed, map each step to official endpoints, permissions, safety checks, and CLI calls.

output_examples.input: Find how to add members to a Lark group when the CLI has no direct command.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the group membership endpoint, required identifiers, needed permissions, confirmation requirement, and a CLI-ready request summary without executing it.

output_examples.input: Locate a read-only API for listing records in an app table.
output_examples.output: The response checks existing commands, selects the relevant documentation page, and lists the method, endpoint purpose, query fields, response fields, and limits.

output_examples.input: Set a group announcement through raw OpenAPI.
output_examples.output: The response explains the update endpoint, required scope, request fields, user impact, and asks for explicit approval before making a change.

best_practices: Start by checking existing Lark skills and lark-cli commands before using raw OpenAPI.
Use official Feishu or Lark documentation for every method, path, parameter, and permission.
Confirm user intent before write, update, or delete calls.
anti_patterns: Guessing endpoint paths or request bodies from memory.
Running mutating API calls without explaining impact and asking for confirmation.
Using copied endpoints from unofficial sources when official documentation is available.

faq.question: Does this skill call APIs automatically?
faq.answer: It guides API discovery and lark-cli api calls. Execution depends on the host agent, configured tools, and user approval for changes.

faq.question: Which API documentation does it use?
faq.answer: It uses official Feishu and Lark OpenAPI documentation indexes and endpoint pages.

faq.question: Does it need credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. API execution requires lark-cli and valid Feishu or Lark authentication with the required scopes.

faq.question: Can it work in English?
faq.answer: Yes. The source documentation is Chinese, and the skill instructs the agent to translate results for English users.

faq.question: Can it create a new reusable skill?
faq.answer: It can identify APIs that may become reusable skills, but creating a new skill is handled by a separate skill-making workflow.

faq.question: What should I verify before a write request?
faq.answer: Verify the tenant, target resource, affected users, required scopes, request fields, and recovery plan before approving execution.
